title: Shadow of the Imperial Dynasty
next_chapter_hook: Just at this moment, a urgent transmission talisman broke through the air—Ye Qing's voice carried a rare gravity: a traitor had appeared within the alliance, and there were already clues about that person's identity.

text.content: The light of the secret realm's exit was within reach, yet Chen Ji's footsteps froze completely at this moment. Chen Nian's words were like a blade, precisely piercing into the depths of the chessboard he thought he had already fully understood. Was there actually an Imperial Dynasty behind the Holy Sect? That monstrous existence hidden behind the clouds was quietly observing this world.

dialogue.content: Brother, why do you think the Holy Sect dares to be so unbridled? Their ambition has never been merely the position of a single Demon Path Supreme.
Within the cage of the Tianming Lock Key, I heard their schemes. The Imperial Dynasty is the true chess player—Holy Sect is merely a puppet they've pushed to the forefront.

text.content: Chen Ji slowly turned around, his gaze falling on his sister's face, slightly pale from years of imprisonment. His expression remained calm, as if he had merely heard an ordinary remark about today's weather. Yet his right hand hanging at his side had its knuckles already turning white. The Imperial Dynasty. Even in the wildest legends of the cultivation world, that name was as taboo as forbidden, something people dared not mention lightly.

Three words, casually spoken, yet they made Chen Nian's eyes instantly redden. She knew every habit of her brother—when he said "continue", it meant he had completely suppressed all emotional fluctuations into the abyss. That kind of calmness broke her heart more than any anger could.

dialogue.content: The Imperial Dynasty controls the most ancient spiritual vein hub of this continent. The three major sects appear independent, but in reality, each year they must pay the Imperial Dynasty a large amount of spiritual materials as 'territory protection fees'. They don't need to act personally—only gently move the chess pieces to make any disobedient force collapse.

The Holy Sect thinks they are the chess players, but how ridiculous—they don't even know how large the board is. As for you and me, perhaps from the moment of birth we were already placed on this chessboard.

text.content: At this moment, a faint glow emerged from the Tianji Record Fragment at Chen Ji's chest. Mo Xiansheng's soul remnant form flickered within the light—his face that always carried an air of profound mystery now unexpectedly showed a rare expression of shock. His gaze was fixed intently on Chen Nian, as if looking at an existence that should not exist in this world.

dialogue.content: Tianming Lock Key... So that's how it is, so that's how it is! This old one schemed for a thousand years, yet overlooked the most crucial piece!

The Imperial Dynasty... This old one indeed knows of their existence, but never imagined they would be so deeply involved in the chess game. Chen Nian girl, do you know the contact method between the Holy Sect and the Imperial Dynasty?

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted. Mo Xiansheng's question was strange—being an existence that had guarded the soul remnant for a thousand years, why would he inquire about such classified intelligence from Chen Nian? Unless... the 'Imperial Dynasty' he previously knew was fundamentally not the same concept as the 'Imperial Dynasty' he now realized.

dialogue.content: Blood Pact Altar. Every ten years, the Holy Sect secretly holds a blood pact ceremony, and the presiding figure is not the Holy Master himself, but an 'observer' sent by the Imperial Dynasty. That person's presence... was so terrifying that even the Holy Sect's sect master dared not look up directly.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's soul remnant trembled violently, as if struck by some force. He fell silent for a long while before slowly speaking, his voice carrying a hint of bitterness: 'This old one's memories from a thousand years ago have been sealed for too long. So... the Imperial Dynasty has always been there.'

choice.prompt: Chen Ji remained silent for a moment—he needed to make a decision: how to handle this unexpected information?

choices.text: Press for details about the Imperial Dynasty
choices.description: Since the Imperial Dynasty is so mysterious and unpredictable, it's even more necessary to understand their true foundation. Chen Nian spent many years within the Tianming Lock Key and must know more inside information.
choices.visible_cost: Consume time, may alert Mo Xiansheng
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key intelligence about the Imperial Dynasty
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng seems to be hiding something—pressing too hard may expose our own intentions

text.content: Chen Ji slightly nodded, his gaze falling on Chen Nian: 'That observer, have you ever seen their true face?'

choices.description: Mo Xiansheng's reaction was too abnormal—how could an existence that had guarded a soul remnant for a thousand years be so unfamiliar with the Imperial Dynasty? Chen Ji decided to probe directly.
choices.visible_cost: Risk angering Mo Xiansheng and losing this vital source of intelligence.
choices.visible_reward: Force Mo Xiansheng to reveal more hidden information.
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng is your current greatest source of intelligence; offending him carries extremely high risk.

text.content: Chen Ji did not continue pressing Chen Nian, but turned his gaze to the slightly trembling remnant soul, saying indifferently: "Master has guarded the Tianji Record for a thousand years, yet is unaware of the Empire's existence?"

choices.text: Temporarily hold fire and make no move.
choices.description: Too much information requires digestion. Chen Ji decided to suppress his doubts for the moment, secretly observe all parties' reactions, and avoid startling the snake.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain information asymmetry advantage, see through all parties' true attitudes.
choices.risk_hint: The Empire's threat is imminent; delay may miss the opportunity for strategic布局.

text.content: Chen Ji gently exhaled a mouthful of stale air, his expression returning to that harmless appearance: "Let's leave this place first. Some matters need not be rushed."

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul slightly froze, clearly not expecting Chen Ji to be so direct. His ethereal form flickered a few times, and after a moment of silence, he slowly spoke, his voice carrying a trace of self-mockery: "Young friend is indeed perceptive. This old one did conceal some matters."

dialogue.content: A thousand years ago, the complete version of the Tianji Record did indeed record the existence of the Empire. However, in that battle where the lineage was severed, this portion of memory was completely stripped away. This old one only remembers the Empire as an enormous entity, yet cannot recall its specific information.

This is not deliberate concealment, but rather a memory forbidden zone even this old one cannot access. If young friend wishes to investigate, perhaps one can only place hope on the further unsealing of the Tianji Record.

text.content: Chen Ji quietly watched Mo Xiansheng, those deep eyes seeming to penetrate all illusion. He quickly calculated in his heart—were Mo Xiansheng's words truth or falsehood? If true, then even the Tianji Record itself had memory seals placed upon it; that Empire's power was probably far more terrifying than he imagined.

choice.prompt: There seemed to be unfinished meaning in Mo Xiansheng's words, and Chen Ji needed to decide how to respond:

choices.text: Give trust, temporarily do not investigate deeply.
choices.description: Mo Xiansheng is currently the only ally; one should not make an enemy unless absolutely necessary. Show goodwill first to observe the effects.
choices.visible_cost: May lose the opportunity to pursue the truth.
choices.visible_reward: Stabilize Mo Xiansheng, maintain the cooperative relationship.
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng's words are difficult to distinguish between true and false; complete trust may cause great disaster.

text.content: Chen Ji slightly nodded, his expression softening: "Since that is the case, I shall trust Master this once. But if I discover Master still has concealments in the future..."

choices.description: Express understanding verbally, but secretly search for flaws in Mo Xiansheng's words and actions. This is Chen Ji's true style.
choices.visible_cost: Requires consuming energy to continuously observe.
choices.visible_reward: May discover Mo Xiansheng's flaws in subsequent dealings.
choices.risk_hint: If Mo Xiansheng discovers this, he will completely lose trust.

text.content: "Chen Ji appeared relieved on the surface, but in his heart he quietly memorized every micro-expression of Mo Xiansheng at this moment. The fluctuation frequency of the residual soul, the pause positions when speaking, the direction of his wandering gaze—these will all be key evidence for verifying truth and falsehood in the future.\n\nAt this moment, an unprecedented sense of crisis surged in Chen Ji's heart. The chessboard had suddenly expanded countless times, yet the pieces he held were pathetically few. The layout he once thought grand enough was nothing more than children's play before the behemoth of the Imperial Dynasty. The Holy Sect, the Xuanwu Sect, the Tianqing Sect...these relationship networks he had painstakingly built were terrifyingly fragile against true power."

"Chen Nian tightly grasped her brother's hand, her clear eyes carrying a hint of unease. She had spent too long in the cage of the Heavenly Fate Lock, seeing too many faces that appeared compassionate but were truly cruel. So it was with the Holy Sect's people, and even more so with those of the Imperial Dynasty. She feared her brother would also fall into such a chess game, becoming a chess piece in others' eyes."

dialogue.content: "Brother, whatever decision you make, I will stand by your side. But there is one thing I must tell you—the reason the Imperial Dynasty has its eyes on the Chen family is precisely because of the Tianji Record."

text.content: "This sentence was like a thunderclap exploding in Chen Ji's mind. His breath slightly stagnated, a sharp gleam flashing in his eyes. The Chen family, the Tianji Record, the Imperial Dynasty—there was actually such a deep connection between these three. No wonder his father disappeared, no wonder his mother died young, no wonder he had been labeled a 'waste' since he could remember. All of this was being manipulated by someone in the shadows."

"Three words, brief yet powerful. Chen Ji gently patted his sister's hand, signaling her not to worry. His mind had already begun racing at high speed—the Imperial Dynasty wants the Tianji Record, which means there must be something within it that can threaten the Imperial Dynasty. What he has obtained so far is merely the tip of the iceberg. To make the Imperial Dynasty hesitate to act, the Tianji Record must be completed as soon as possible."

choice.prompt: "The situation is becoming increasingly complex, and Chen Ji needs to replan his next course of action:"

choices.description: "The more complete the Tianji Record, the stronger the power. All fragments must be gathered as quickly as possible to have the capital to compete with the Imperial Dynasty."
choices.visible_reward: "Increased Tianji Record power unlocks more hidden information"
choices.risk_hint: "The process of searching for fragments will inevitably attract the attention of various forces"

text.content: "Chen Ji quietly calculated in his mind the locations of the known fragments. There might be clues in the Ancient Forbidden Land, and Ling Yuan is also suspected of holding one page. The next layout must center on retrieving the fragments."

choices.text: "Secretly investigate the Imperial Dynasty's true details"
choices.description: "Know yourself and know your enemy, and you will be safe in every battle. Before making a move, the specific strength and layout of the Imperial Dynasty must be thoroughly understood."
choices.visible_cost: "Takes a long time, may miss golden opportunities"
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain first-hand intelligence on the Imperial Dynasty"
choices.risk_hint: "Investigating the Imperial Dynasty itself is an extremely dangerous endeavor"

text.content: "Ye Qing is the Holy Sect's Saintess; she may know something about the connection between the Holy Sect and the Imperial Dynasty. And the conversations Chen Nian overheard within the Heavenly Fate Lock also need to be sorted through one by one. All clues point in the same direction—the Imperial Dynasty."

choices.text: "Prepare on both fronts, parallel advancement on two lines"
choices.description: "While searching for fragments to increase strength, also secretly investigate the Imperial Dynasty's layout. Advancing on two lines simultaneously, with risks and opportunities coexisting."
choices.visible_reward: "Comprehensively control the situation, advance and retreat with composure"
choices.risk_hint: "Greedy for too much, advancing on two lines simultaneously may lead to failure on both fronts"

text.content: A determined gleam flashed across Chen Ji's eyes. Since the chessboard had already expanded to this extent, he had no reason to retreat. The trash persona still needed to be maintained, but the covert arrangements had to be comprehensively upgraded. From this moment on, he would no longer merely play chess against the Holy Sect, but against the entire dynasty.

Just as Chen Ji was sketching the outline of his new chess game in his heart, the light at the secret realm's exit quietly flickered on. The moment the three stepped out of the secret realm, familiar spiritual energy fluctuations washed over them—the Tianqing Sect's mountain gate stood silently in the distance, surrounded by morning mist, everything appearing so peaceful and serene, as if the tumultuous waves of the secret realm had been but an illusory dream.

Yet Chen Ji knew this was merely the calm before the storm. The dynasty's existence was like a sharp sword hanging overhead, ready to fall at any moment. His time was even more urgent than he had imagined. Originally he thought he only needed to deal with the Holy Sect and the Three Great Sects, but now he suddenly discovered that above them all, an even more massive hand was manipulating everything.

dialogue.content: "Nian'er, you first follow me back to rest. There are some things that need to be sorted through gradually."

text.content: Chen Nian nodded obediently, though countless words swirled in her heart, she knew at this moment the most important thing was not words, but companionship. Her brother's back remained thin, yet she distinctly felt the heaviness hidden beneath the calm surface. After years apart, the burdens on his shoulders were far heavier than she had imagined.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul quietly faded into the Tianji Record, leaving behind profound words before departing: "Young friend, though the chessboard is vast, the one who plays the game can never forget their own position. This old man will do his utmost to unlock more memories, but before that, you need to survive." As the words fell, the remnant soul completely vanished within the Tianji Record's glow.

Chen Ji stood alone in the morning mist, gazing toward the Tianqing Sect's mountain gate. His eyes were deep as an abyss, as if gazing at an invisible enemy. Trash Chen Ji, the most inconspicuous servant disciple of Tianqing Sect—how much longer could this persona be maintained? Since the dynasty had already taken notice of the Tianji Record, their scouts had probably already infiltrated every corner.

dialogue.content: "It seems it's time to accelerate the progress."

text.content: Chen Ji murmured quietly, his tone betraying no emotional fluctuation whatsoever. He had already rearranged the positions of his chess pieces in his mind—Su Qingyao's investigation, Ling Yuan's ambition, Ye Qing's intelligence network, the dynasty's shadow... all the clues rapidly interwove in his thoughts, forming an increasingly massive and increasingly dangerous web. And he himself stood at the center of this web, bearing alone the pressure from all directions.

Just then, an urgent communication talisman pierced through the air, landing precisely in Chen Ji's hand. The energy on the talisman was all too familiar to him—it was Ye Qing. The voice within carried rare gravity, utterly unlike her usual enchanting, world-weary demeanor: a traitor had appeared within the alliance, and clues about that person's identity had already emerged.

Chen Ji's eyes narrowed slightly, yet a meaningful smile curled at the corner of his lips. Indeed, the chess game would never proceed according to his expectations. Just after learning of the dynasty's existence, internal divisions began to surface. Was all this coincidence, or was someone secretly stirring the waters? His fingers gently stroked the communication talisman, knuckles slightly tensing, crushing that talisman completely into powder.

Dynasty, traitor, Chen Nian, Tianji Record... all the clues tangled together like tangled hemp, and Chen Ji had to find a path leading to victory within this mess. Trash persona? Pretending to be weak to devour the strong? From this moment onward, these were no longer sufficient. What he needed was true power—the kind of power sufficient to shake the dynasty.
